recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Maintain future abatement-extension changes in HL7/fhir-extensions; do not add a native AllergyIntolerance.abatement[x] element in core without a new final Patient Care decision superseding FHIR-47615.
issue_request: Published FHIR-core/Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to add AllergyIntolerance abatement[x] as a 0..1 extension with value choices dateTime, Age, Period, Range, and string plus definition/comment text explaining when the allergy or intolerance resolved.
initial_application: Core commit 89170aaa03115a9f408c1cf12fac8d86c2694e48 explicitly applied GF#17810 by adding the abatement extension row to source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with the requested shape and wording. Later commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed AllergyIntolerance extension definitions from R5 core source as extension content moved out of the core checkout.
additional_context: The active AllergyIntolerance resource remains in the core build, but the canonical abatement extension source is now /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/AllergyIntolerance/StructureDefinition-allergyintolerance-abatement.xml. Related decisions FHIR-47505, FHIR-52938, and FHIR-47615 respectively deprecated the older resolutionAge extension in favor of abatement, clarified the Period/Range comment, and declined elevating abatement into the base AllergyIntolerance resource for R6.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source change was made. Re-adding the extension definition to core would be wrong because the active artifact belongs in the Extension Pack, and the current external definition already carries the FHIR-17810 semantics plus later clarifications.
